user.title: Connect Calling Messenger Hub
user.description: Enter the add-on URL and API token. Copy the token from the add-on at Settings → API token for custom integration.

data_description.url: Example: http://local-calling-messenger-hub:3030 for a local add-on. Use the repository hostname for remote installs.
data_description.token: Bearer token used to call the add-on REST API; copy it from the add-on Settings.
data_description.scan_interval: Time between account and call state refreshes.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the add-on. Check the URL, port, and that the add-on is running.
error.unknown: Unknown error while connecting to the add-on.

data_description.notify_service: Legacy single service; used only when Notification services is empty. For example notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.notify_services: Comma or newline separated notify services. For example notify.mobile_app_phone, notify.mobile_app_tablet.
data_description.notify_critical_services: When set, critical events go only to these services instead of the main list.
data_description.notify_events: Only send notifications for the selected event types.
data_description.notify_accounts: Only send for accounts matching ID, name, phone or service type; comma separated. Empty = all.
data_description.notify_severities: Only send events with the selected severities; events without a severity count as Info.
data_description.notify_quiet_start: HH:MM in the Home Assistant timezone. Set both start and end to enable quiet hours.
data_description.notify_quiet_end: HH:MM in the Home Assistant timezone. Critical events still bypass quiet hours.
data_description.notify_cooldown: Skip duplicate notifications for the same type, account and sender within this window. 0 = off.
data_description.notify_url: Dashboard or web page opened by the Open action. Call back opens the dialer; Open chat opens a Telegram/Zalo conversation when available.
